d_and_a.source: TOTAL D&A = us-gaap:Depreciation (752/764/762) + us-gaap:AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets (7,946/7,622/7,377), both filed in acc. 0001551152-26-000008. Amortization is included because EBIT is after ~$7.4-7.9B intangible amortization; depreciation alone (762) would understate the non-cash add-back ~10x. verify_value's d_and_a tag matches only the Depreciation component.

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY25 growth was 8.6% but Humira erosion is lapping and Skyrizi/Rinvoq growth offsets; fade to ~4% as patent exposure grows.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY25 margin 24.6% and FY23 23.5% were depressed by IPR&D/acquisition charges; amortization declining (7.4B FY25); assume recovery to 31%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: below 21% US statutory given AbbVie's international mix; not taken from a filing, reviewer to verify against 10-K effective rate.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY25 total D&A 8,139/61,160=13.3%, trending down as acquired intangibles amortize (7.9B->7.4B).

wacc.source: CAPM: rf 4.86% (UST 10Y 2026-11-06) + relevered beta 1.02 (Damodaran Drugs (Pharmaceutical) unlevered cash-corrected 0.915, industry D/E 0.145, tax 21%) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US 2026-02) = 9.4% CoE; pretax Kd 6.02% after-tax 4.76%; weights 87.3/12.7 (industry) -> 8.8%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below long-run nominal GDP and below 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: Deskstack derived: total debt 67,496 (LT 58,941 + current 6,056 + ST borrowings 2,499) - cash 5,229 - ST investments 28; acc. 0001551152-26-000008

Tools: the deskstack data tools (SEC and EU ESEF filings, rates, Damodaran inputs). Use them for every filed figure. After you submit, independent reviewers will check the model and you will get one chance to fix it.

Build a quick unlevered DCF for AbbVie Inc. (identifier: ABBV).
- History: revenue, operating income (EBIT), D&A and capex for the last three filed fiscal years.
- Five projected years with your assumptions: revenue growth per year, EBIT margin, tax rate, D&A and capex as % of
  revenue, WACC and terminal growth, each with its rationale as the source.
- Bridge: net debt and diluted shares at the last fiscal year end (shares in the same scale as the money figures).
Submit it with submit_model, kind "dcf".
